site_info.site_description: Linde Gas Sverige operates an online shop and corporate portal for industrial, medical and specialty gases and related equipment in Sweden. The company is described as the world's leading industrial gas company. Products include gases such as acetylene, argon, carbon dioxide, helium, hydrogen, nitrogen, oxygen, propane, refrigerants, welding and shielding gases, medical gases and food-grade gases, as well as gas equipment, regulators, burners, cutting equipment and medical devices. The site offers online purchasing, a customer portal, technical advisory, training and maintenance services for industries including metallurgy, chemicals, food, environmental protection, glass, electronics, pharmaceuticals and healthcare.
site_info.purpose: Online shop and corporate information site for Linde Gas Sverige, covering industrial, medical and specialty gases, gas equipment, applications and customer services.

site_info.site_description: The website of Sveriges advokatsamfund (the Swedish Bar Association), a professional body for Swedish lawyers. It states that only those admitted by the association may call themselves advokat, and presents the association's core values of independence, confidentiality, freedom from conflicts of interest and client loyalty. The site provides paths for the public to find or engage a lawyer, for lawyers and law-firm staff, for those seeking to become lawyers, and for journalists, alongside news, press and referral-response sections. It also links to the disciplinary board, the consumer dispute board, the supervision unit, the legal library (Juridiska biblioteket), the training academy (Advokatakademien) and the magazine Advokaten. Statistics on the profession by gender are published.
site_info.purpose: Website of the Swedish Bar Association, presenting the association, its rules for the advokat title, services for lawyers and the public, news, library, training and disciplinary/supervisory bodies.
business_activities: Admission and regulation of the advokat title in Sweden
Supervision, disciplinary and consumer dispute functions for lawyers
Information and news for lawyers, clients and journalists
